t: The LAP Fulgora tilt downlight is a round, indoor lighting fixture designed for domestic installations. This mains-powered downlight features a stylish brushed nickel bezel, making it ideal for modern kitchens, living rooms, or hallways. It requires 1 x GU10 light bulb, sold separately, and offers a tilt function for adjustable light direction. Features loop in, loop out terminals, offering an easy wire connection, simplifying installation. With an IP20 rating, it is suitable for dry indoor environments and has a compact 28mm depth, fitting a 72-74mm cut-out.
b: Loop In & Loop Out Terminals Simplify Wiring
